BiblicalUsage: Shepho is the son of Shobal the Horite. He is named among the dukes of Edom in the genealogy of Seir.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a duke of Edom is still worth naming, because the families of the field are counted as carefully as the families of the promise.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
